syncStrategy: Firebase canonical state + monotonic syncRevision + per-target revision guards + processed-operation deduplication + Firestore transactions + realtime onSnapshot + persisted targeted mutation queue
label: Realtime cloud sync
startupRule: when Google is authenticated, cloud is read before UI is revealed; local cache never writes merely because the page opened or refreshed
realtimeRule: all snapshots with a newer syncRevision are applied regardless of source device or browser tab
offlineRule: only explicit user mutations are persisted and replayed over the latest cloud state after reconnection
conflictRule: unrelated targets merge; an operation cannot overwrite a target changed after its baseRevision; causally newer same-session actions may supersede their own in-flight predecessor; already processed operation IDs are idempotent
progressSource: progressByContext; tasks is only the current-context render mirror
progressAnimation: same-target rerenders keep the active animation; changed targets continue from the visible value
tests: node syntax for every JS file
phone-to-PC and PC-to-phone targeted operation merge model
stale same-target mutation rejection and unrelated-target merge
causally newer same-target action after an in-flight predecessor
browserSmoke: Chromium dump-dom was unavailable in the container because the headless process did not exit; no claim of live Firebase end-to-end testing is made
